Modification by IndustriAgents on 2026-11-05: filter __proto__, constructor
and prototype keys from both source and target, at every merge depth.
Addresses GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4. Remove this override when a reviewed upstream
fix is available. Test coverage lives in website/scripts/deepmerge.test.mjs.

Rebuild from the repository root with:
npm pack ./website/vendor/deepmerge-safe --pack-destination website/vendor
